name: features_advertised
invariant: INV-20 — a host is written to only for scopes it advertises
notes: The features[] list the desktop hub advertises over GET /api/v1/cluster, read from the single source sync::HUB_FEATURES (so it can never drift from the routes the hub mounts). Today the hub serves exactly two journal scopes; phase 7a grows this list (registry_reads, chat, ...) as the website host learns to serve them, and the same list must then be served unchanged by the website — the cross-host parity assertion INV-20 names.
